Our Vision

Welcome to Ghilman Academy

Your Path to Knowledge

Ghilman Academy offers an enriching online Islamic educational experience, connecting students worldwide with dedicated, Al-Azhar certified tutors tailored to their individual learning needs.

Our core mission is to make authentic Islamic knowledge universally accessible, fostering a community of learners passionate about Quranic study, Arabic language proficiency, and deep Islamic understanding.

The Journey Begins

Our Inspirational Story

Founded by a group of devoted educators, Ghilman Academy emerged to fulfill the need for quality online Islamic learning amidst a changing educational landscape.

Over the years, we have successfully taught thousands of students, continuously enhancing our programs and adapting to meet the growing demand for personalized online education.

Pricing

✔ Affordable & Transparent:
 Premium Quran, Arabic and Islamic education at Gilman Academy with zero registration fees.
✔ Seamless Learning from Home:
 Embark on a transformative spiritual journey with flexible schedules tailored for both children and adults.
✔ Customized Packages:
 From foundational Quranic reading to advanced Tajweed in addition to Arabic language and Islamic studies different levels, choose the ideal plan that aligns perfectly with your goals.
✔ Secure & Flexible Payments:
Payments are processed in USD or the equivalent value in your country’s local currency via Bank Transfer, PayPal, or Credit/Debit Cards.
